summary: A modal window on a glass surface with an optional title and actions.
purpose: Present focused content or a decision on top of the page. Reach for it instead of a raw MUI Dialog so the glass aesthetic, backdrop blur, and tokens hold.

anatomy.description: A blurred, tinted scrim behind the modal.
The modal body, rendered from children.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional action buttons, usually Button atoms.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown (from MUI DialogProps).

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on backdrop click or Escape (from MUI DialogProps).

whenToUse: A focused modal for a decision, a detail view, or a short flow.
Any overlay that should trap focus and dim the page.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Asking one required structuring question with fixed options

do: Give the dialog a title so it has an accessible name.
Put actions in the actions slot as Button atoms.
dont: Use a dialog for content that belongs inline on the page.

keyboard: Escape closes when onClose is provided.
Focus is trapped inside while open and restored on close.
aria: The title provides the accessible name; pass one, or set aria-label.
accessibility.contrast: Title and content hold at least 4.5:1 against the glass panel.
accessibility.focus: Focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the trigger on close.

examples.title: Plan modal
examples.code: <Dialog open={open} onClose={close} title={activeCase.title} actions={<Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={close}>Close</Button>}>{body}</Dialog>

related.whenToChoose: ClarifyingDialog is a specialized single-question modal built on Dialog.
Surface is the glass panel without the modal behavior.
